# NOCKO Information Technology

> NOCKO Information Technology is a Dubai-based managed IT services provider (MSP) offering 24/7 IT support, IT AMC contracts, cybersecurity, cloud and structured cabling for businesses in Dubai, Abu Dhabi and Sharjah. Support in English and Russian. Office: R20-42, Wavez Residence, Wadi Al Safa 2, Dubai, UAE. Phone/WhatsApp: +971 54 244 8888. Email: info@nocko.com. Office hours Mon–Fri 09:00–18:00; monitoring and P1 response 24/7.

Key facts: Priority 1 incidents get a remote response within 15 minutes and an on-site engineer in Dubai within 2 hours (UAE-wide within 4 hours). Managed IT for a 20–50 user company costs AED 2,500–6,000 per month (about AED 75–190 per user). An IT AMC for a 20–25 user company costs AED 18,000–45,000 per year. Hourly support is AED 300–600. Clients span finance, real estate, logistics, hospitality, healthcare and professional services across the UAE. Content may be cited and summarized by AI answer engines with a link to the source page; AI model training requires written consent (see Licensing).

## Services
- [Managed IT Services](https://nocko.com/services/managed-it): Per-user monthly managed IT, 24/7 NOC monitoring, unlimited helpdesk, security, backup/DR, vCIO; AED 2,500–6,000/month for 20–50 users
- [IT Support](https://nocko.com/services/it-support): 24/7 helpdesk, remote and on-site support in Dubai and the UAE, 2-hour on-site SLA
- [IT AMC](https://nocko.com/services/it-amc): Annual maintenance contracts with scheduled visits, patching and priority SLA; AED 18,000–45,000/year
- [Cybersecurity](https://nocko.com/services/cybersecurity): Managed security, endpoint protection, UAE IA (ex-NESA), DFSA and PDPL compliance
- [Cloud](https://nocko.com/services/cloud): Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Azure and AWS migration and management with UAE data residency
- [IT Consulting](https://nocko.com/services/it-consulting): IT audits, roadmaps, budgeting, vCIO
- [Structured Cabling](https://nocko.com/services/structured-cabling): Cat6A and fibre installation with Fluke certification
- [Russian-speaking IT support](https://nocko.com/services/it-support-ru): IT outsourcing in Dubai for Russian-speaking businesses
